title: Xingcheng governed Internet access
summary: Authorize native Internet access for Xingcheng while preserving its native-only and no-external-execution boundaries.

changes.proposed: XINGCHENG-NATIVE-ONLY:the complete Xingcheng source,production runtime,training,inference,learning,evaluation,data-processing and internal-tool surface uses only C+C++23+CSharp+FSharp+Rust;this is a strict Xingcheng-specific subset and no project-wide language permission expands it;OWNERSHIP:C and Rust own deterministic runtime+lifecycle+security+data hot paths,C++23 solely owns model training+inference+artifact production,CSharp owns bounded application+workflow orchestration,FSharp owns evaluation+validation+high-correctness analysis;EXCLUDED:Go+JavaScript+Bun+WebView script+Python and every other source or execution language are prohibited inside Xingcheng;INTERNET-ACCESS:Xingcheng may access the Internet through its own Rust or CSharp native network path for search+public-data retrieval+repair research+authorized task completion;every request has declared purpose+scope+bounded concurrency+deadline+response-size limit+source record+content validation+audit and cancellation;all retrieved content is untrusted non-authoritative input;EXTERNAL-DEPENDENCY:Internet data access is not an external execution dependency and does not authorize any external model+cloud inference+remote code execution+external execution engine+third-party inference framework+third-party training framework+external capability service as a Xingcheng runtime,producer,consumer,reference,fallback or authority;PLATFORM-BOUNDARY:operating-system facilities+hardware drivers+approved build toolchains+governed typed channels may provide platform boundaries only and gain no Xingcheng capability,model,data or authority ownership;TRAINING remains an internal Xingcheng service capability and not an independent module or tool;MODEL_TRAINING remains retired;FAILURE:any excluded language,external execution dependency,unbounded or unaudited network operation,or unregistered executor is denied fail-closed.
